description: Collapse the TS<->Python seams and port the graph routes (docs/UNIFIED-PROJECT-PLAN.md §5). The two integration points that exist today — the HTTP sidecar client and the CLI-subprocess acquisition — become direct in-process calls into pinakes_engine, and /api/graph/* is served from the Python service. This is the template every later port tasklist follows.

userStories.title: Engine in-process (kill the sidecar + subprocess seams)
userStories.description: Replace the sidecar HTTP client and the CLI-subprocess acquisition with direct in-process calls into pinakes_engine. The FastAPI service imports the engine; there is no more :8800 hop and no `python -m ... fetch` spawn.
acceptanceCriteria: The functionality of the former culturescrape-client (search/metrics/completeness/datalog/neo4j/retrieve) and culturescrape-acquisition (fetch) is provided by in-process engine calls from the Python service.
No HTTP call to a Python sidecar and no CLI subprocess remain in the request path.
Neo4j access is consolidated in Python (the engine's driver); the former TS neo4j-driver usage for these paths is gone.

userStories.title: Port /api/graph/* to the Python service
userStories.description: Implement the graph route group (search, retrieve, metrics, datalog, cypher, node/neighborhood/overview) as an auto-registered router on the FastAPI service, backed by the in-process engine.
acceptanceCriteria: Every /api/graph/* route the client uses is served by the Python service and passes the parity tests (response shapes match the baseline).
The route module is auto-registered (no shared-app edit) and self-contained.
The corresponding Express /api/graph/* handlers are removed or return 501 (coverage tracker updated).
